source_annotations.note: The third glyph of GVGAG is G, with a visible right-hand bar in the detail crop. An initial C-like visual impression is not used as a mask or a source edit.
The first glyph of XDXFX has a detached lower-left ink fragment, but its crossed diagonals remain visible. The detail crop confirms X; an initial Y-like visual impression is not used.

prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Nov1–3 key with original provenance.

limits: Only four newly source-edited physical records enter the proposal and primary totals. The already cataloged p89_A2 is linked with Ayush Agarwal credit and is not modified or recounted.

The100-coordinate loss in A3 is explicitly declared and located by the source. Its69filled lost coordinates are editorial hypotheses constrained by surviving coordinates and language, not independently recovered copies.

The third-part tail is retained exactly as raw, including unresolved letters, apparent military/garrison fragments and possible references. It is not normalized from the following civilian/Berlin text.
SIEGFRIED is retained as a source name without an independent identification of a vessel or unit.
All unmodified numerical labels, references and routing abbreviations remain literal.
The printed cleartext after part5 is separate from the encrypted coordinates and contributes no plaintext-position count.
Exact witness re-encryption verifies compatibility and editing costs, not a unique historical restoration.
